title: NBA Sim Event Catalog (foundation 0.15.0)
description: Closed catalog of every EventType for v0.2. Each event declares the GameState dot-paths it mutates, the actors it requires, and its same-timestamp priority rank (1=highest, 6=lowest). Catalog size is fixed at 41 for foundation 0.15.0; additive payload fields remain backward compatible and are validated by the kernel event contract.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the catalog contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

events.$comment: Uniqueness of each item's `type` is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter) and by the `jq '.events[].type' | sort -u | wc -l` verification gate, not by this schema. JSON Schema (draft-07) has no portable keyword for cross-item unique property values; the ajv-keywords `uniqueItemProperties` extension is intentionally omitted to keep ajv-cli strict-mode validation clean.

type.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE event name. Unique across the catalog (enforced by uniqueItemProperties when ajv-keywords is loaded; otherwise by the foundation linter in todo 9).

actors_min.description: Minimum number of distinct player/coach actors referenced in payload.

actors_max.description: Maximum number of actors. Must be >= actors_min (enforced by allOf branches for actors_min 0..5; larger values rejected).

required_payload_fields.description: Payload keys every instance of this event MUST carry.

optional_payload_fields.description: Payload keys an instance MAY carry in addition to the required set.

mutates.description: Dot-paths into GameState that this event may mutate when applied by the fold. CamelCase field names (e.g. ball.holderId, clocks.shot, score.home, possession.team, phase, fouls.player). Empty array = cosmetic-only event.

same_ts_priority_rank.description: Precedence when multiple events share the same t_game. 1 resolves first, 6 resolves last. Cross-referenced by docs/foundation/invariants.md (T4).

notes.description: Short human-readable description of when the event is emitted.

allOf.$comment: Enforce actors_max >= actors_min for the value range used by the catalog (0..5). Values of actors_min >= 6 are rejected by the final branch.
